$comment: contract-v1.1 (v1.2 adds the leak_judge and tab_occluded sealed-only types; v1.3 adds sealedEverywhereTypes / sealedEverywhereReasons and the tab_visible sealed companion): the ONE shared blinding list. Read by ad-contracts (events.ts / blinding.ts: the client-side blinded guard) and by tools/phaseD/check_blinding.mjs, so they cannot drift. armKeyPatterns are regex fragments joined as ^(?:a|b|...)$ with flag i (exactly protocol 4's ARM_KEYS). contract-v1.5 adds contract (the version this list belongs to), eventTypes (the allowlist of every bh-ad/1 v1.x event type; anything else is rejected unknown_event_type), uploadForbiddenTypes (gaze_raw: rejected gaze_raw_forbidden on every upload), simMarkerPattern (the sim-only build markers, see README: rejected sim_marker on every upload) and maxBaseSessionIdLength (121, so <id>.sealed fits 128). v2 types (survey, pilot_*) are added when v2 lands. contract-v1.5 also adds the pointer_l1 and model_change types (Mac pointer mode and model picker); the input-mode fence (input-mode.ts) is code, not data.
